# sendgrid_ip_address (Data Source)

Retrieves the current details of a dedicated IP address already on the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_ip_address" "dedicated" {
  ip = "203.0.113.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The dedicated IP address to look up.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (Number) Unix timestamp indicating when the IP address was added to the account.
- `id` (String) The IP address (identical to `ip`).
- `is_auto_warmup` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is set to automatically warm up.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is billed and able to send email.
- `is_leased` (Boolean) Whether the IP address is leased from Twilio SendGrid.
- `is_parent_assigned` (Boolean) Whether a parent account user is able to send email from this IP address.
- `pools` (List of String) Names of the IP pools this IP address currently belongs to.
- `subusers` (Set of String) Numeric Subuser IDs assigned to send from this IP address.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp indicating when the IP address was last updated, if ever.
